name: revu
description: Turn a revu code review into action — discuss, apply, or live-watch the line annotations you captured in the revu TUI.

setup.instructions: Install the CLI with `npm install -g @kud/revu-cli`, then run `revu` in a git repo to annotate a diff (press ↵ on a line). The skills read the annotations revu autosaves to .revu.json. Verify with: revu --help
